businessType.title:
Tell Us About
Your Business
businessType.subtitle: Your business type and size go determine your CIT rate, VAT filing, and e-invoice timeline. E go take small time.
businessType.turnoverLabel: How much money your business dey turn per year
businessType.turnoverHint: We go use am determine your VAT filing status and e-invoice phase. You fit change am later.
businessType.whyBody: Nigeria tax law dey tie your CIT rate, VAT filing exemption, and e-invoicing deadline to your business type and turnover. If we get am right, no go get surprise.

descriptions.sole_trader: Good for one-person business and freelance work wey use personal tax rules.
descriptions.partnership: For business wey partners dey share profit and responsibility together.
descriptions.limited_company: For registered company wey need company tax guidance and annual filing support.
descriptions.ngo: For mission work, association, and non-profit wey still need clean compliance record.

tinVerify.title: Enter Your TIN
tinVerify.body: Your Tax Identification Number go dey for every invoice wey you send. Na how NRS go know your business.
tinVerify.formatHint: E dey usually 8–14 digits. Check your NRS certificate or old FIRS documents.
tinVerify.nrsNote: NRS (Nigeria Revenue Service, before dem call am FIRS) dey manage am
tinVerify.pendingNote: Verification fit take 1–2 minutes through NRS. We go notify you when e confirm.
tinVerify.whtWarningTitle: No TIN = dem go cut 10% from every payment
tinVerify.whtWarningBody: Your clients go hold back 10% WHT from any payment wey dey go business without TIN. That money hard to recover.
tinVerify.educationBody: Correct TIN dey make payment easier, reduce unnecessary withholding tax, and help clients approve your invoice faster. Na the most important step for your tax health.

vatSetup.title: VAT Setup
vatSetup.exemptTitle: You no need file VAT return!
vatSetup.exemptBody: If your business dey below 100 million naira, you no need submit VAT return. But — you still need charge 7.5% VAT for every invoice.
vatSetup.exemptDetail: Your annual turnover dey below ₦100M, so you no need submit monthly VAT return to NRS. TaxBridge go notify you if your turnover change.
vatSetup.requiredTitle: You must file VAT return every month
vatSetup.requiredBody: Your turnover don pass ₦100M, so VAT return must submit before 21st every month.
vatSetup.requiredDetail: If you file late, NRS fit charge penalty. TaxBridge go send reminder before each deadline.
vatSetup.rate: Standard rate for goods and services
vatSetup.distinctionTitle: Two things wey you need know about VAT
vatSetup.chargingBody: Every Nigerian business must add 7.5% VAT to invoice for taxable goods and services. TaxBridge dey do this automatically.
vatSetup.filingExemptBody: You no need file return because your turnover dey under ₦100M. This fit change if your business grow.
vatSetup.filingRequiredBody: You must file before 21st every month. TaxBridge go remind you and help calculate the amount.
vatSetup.educationTitle: TaxBridge dey handle this for you
vatSetup.educationBody: Every invoice wey you create for TaxBridge go automatically include correct 7.5% VAT line. If filing dey required, we go prepare your return summary with one tap.

einvoice.title: E-Invoice — New Law
einvoice.phaseSmall: E-invoice go become compulsory for your business size by July 2027. If you start now, banks go trust your records more.
einvoice.phaseMedium: Pilot phase don start. E go compulsory by July 1 2026. Apply for FIRSMBS integration now.
einvoice.phaseLarge: E-invoice enforcement don start for businesses your size. NRS fit fine you if you no comply.
einvoice.enforcementBody: Business wey get ₦5B+ turnover must issue compliant e-invoice. Penalty na ₦200,000 per offence plus 100% of tax for uninvoiced transactions.

large.label: Big companies (₦5B+)
large.desc: Enforcement don start since April 2026. Full compliance dey required.

medium.label: Medium companies (₦1B+)
medium.desc: Pilot dey go on. E go compulsory from July 2026.

small.label: Small & micro business
small.desc: No compulsory until July 2027. Early adoption mean better trust score.

einvoice.platform: E-invoice dey go through FIRSMBS (NRS Merchant-Buyer Solution). TaxBridge go connect to this platform for your behalf.
einvoice.educationBody: Business wey start e-invoice early go get faster loan approval, smoother audit, and higher trust score with bigger clients and banks. TaxBridge go make am easy.

community.shareBody: Show clients and partners say your business dey NRS-compliant. Strong badge dey build trust and fit open better payment terms.
community.benefitBody: Connect with thousands of Nigerian business owners. Get early access to new features, tax law change alerts, and advice from others wey dey navigate the same compliance journey.
